body_html:
Where can you buy Fruit of the Loom in Europe and Ireland?

Fruit of the Loom is sold in more than 100 countries, and in Europe it reaches customers through four very different channels: official online retailers, the brand's own EU shop, big marketplaces such as Amazon and OTTO, and the blank-apparel wholesalers that supply print shops. Prices for the identical T-shirt or hoodie can differ by 30 % or more between those channels, and delivery times range from two days to two weeks. This guide lists only shops whose pages we loaded and checked ourselves in September 2026, with what each is good for, how fast they deliver and how returns work.

Which shop is cheapest and fastest? Our top pick

For private customers and small groups in Ireland and the EU, the cheapest verified option is {{SHOP|Marmalade Co.}}, an official Fruit of the Loom retailer based in Copenhagen. It buys directly from the Fruit of the Loom factory in Morocco and sells in EUR including VAT:

  • T-shirt from €6.95 (€6.26 each at 5+), long-sleeve €8.95, polo €10.95, crewneck sweatshirt €16.95, {{SHOP:/collections/hoodies-herre|hoodie}} €20.95 (€18.86 at 5+), zip hoodie €27.95, sweatpants €16.95
  • Quantity discounts on most products: 3 pcs 5 % off, 5+ pcs 10 % off
  • Shipping: €7 flat by DHL, dispatch within 0–1 business day, estimated delivery 2–3 business days, tracking by e-mail
  • Ships to Ireland, Germany, France, the Netherlands, Belgium, Austria, Italy, Spain, Portugal, Poland and Finland
  • Price guarantee: finds the identical product cheaper, they match it (excludes Black Friday-type promotions and out-of-stock items)
  • Trustpilot 4.7/5 and 25,000+ customers according to the shop at the time of writing

It is not the right choice for everyone: it does not print, the underwear and sock range is small, and it does not ship to every EU country. For those cases the shops below fill the gaps. For a straight price comparison by product see {{LINK:cheapest|the cheapest place to buy Fruit of the Loom in Europe}}.

{{CTA:/collections/all|Browse the full Fruit of the Loom range at the cheapest verified prices in Europe — €7 DHL shipping, 2–3 day delivery and a price guarantee.|Shop at Marmalade Co.}}

Online shops and marketplaces across Europe

Fruit of the Loom official EU shop (fruitoftheloom.eu)

The brand's own European web shop, run by Fruit of the Loom International from Kaiserslautern, Germany. It carries the complete current catalogue — Valueweight, Original, Iconic, Classic sweats, polos and kids' styles — and is the best reference for official style numbers and colour names. Prices are usually higher than at discount retailers, so use it to identify the exact model and then compare.

Amazon.de and Amazon.ie

Amazon Germany lists hundreds of Fruit of the Loom items, from single tees to multipacks, sold both by Amazon and by third-party sellers, and ships to most EU countries. Amazon.ie is the Irish storefront with EUR pricing and delivery within Ireland. The catch on both is that prices, shipping charges and delivery times vary from seller to seller, so always compare the total at checkout and check who is actually selling the item.

OTTO (otto.de)

One of Germany's biggest online department stores, with around 245 Fruit of the Loom listings at the time of writing across tees, hoodies, sweatshirts, jog pants and multipacks for men, women and kids. German-language and mainly serving customers in Germany.

Shops that deliver to Ireland

EMP Ireland (emp.ie)

The Irish storefront of the European merchandise and alternative-fashion retailer EMP. Around 20 Fruit of the Loom basics at the time of writing — T-shirts from about €7.99 and hoodies from about €26.99 — shipped by DHL, with free delivery on orders over €99.99.

Country Clothing, Sligo (countryclothing.ie)

An Irish country and workwear retailer in Kintogher, Sligo, and one of the few physical shops in Ireland we could verify stocking the brand. Around 50 Fruit of the Loom items online — Valueweight tees from €4.99, polos from €9.99, Classic Hooded Sweats around €21.99 at the time of writing — with free delivery within Ireland over €50, free click-and-collect and 30-day returns.

Clothes2order Ireland (clothes2order.ie)

The Irish storefront of the UK print-and-embroidery specialist. The full Fruit of the Loom range can be ordered blank or personalised with no minimum order, and many printed items dispatch next day. Prices are shown in EUR, but orders ship from the UK, so allow extra transit time and check for any post-Brexit charges at checkout.

Wholesalers for printers, clubs and businesses

Ntextil (ntextil.ie)

An Irish blank-apparel wholesaler aimed at printers, clubs, schools and businesses, with more than 60 Fruit of the Loom styles in XS–5XL. Wholesale list prices sit around €6.40 for a Valueweight T and €22.70 for a Classic Hooded Sweat, with deep outlet discounts on selected stock (approx., September 2026). Most orders dispatch within 48 hours via An Post, DHL or UPS. Best value when you buy in quantity.

Textil-Großhandel.eu

A German textile wholesaler and printer carrying the complete Fruit of the Loom catalogue — Valueweight, Premium, Iconic, Lightweight and Classic lines — with in-house screen printing, embroidery, flex and DTF. Wholesale prices are shown after registration, so it suits businesses ordering in bulk rather than private shoppers. If you are ordering blanks for a print run, our {{LINK:bulk-tshirts|guide to buying blank T-shirts in bulk}} explains how quantity pricing works.

Two general rules help. Under EU consumer rules you can normally return an unused item bought online within 14 days of delivery, but personalised or printed garments are usually excluded, so double-check sizes before you print. And when a marketplace listing looks unusually cheap, check the seller, the shipping cost and whether the size is EU or US before you buy.

How do you know it is genuine Fruit of the Loom?

  • Buy from an official or authorised retailer, the brand's own shop or a recognised wholesaler — all of the shops above fit that description.
  • Look for the official style number (for example 61-036 Valueweight T, 62-208 Classic Hooded Sweat) in the listing; genuine stock is sold by those numbers.
  • Check the neck label and the care label: Fruit of the Loom garments carry the brand's woven or printed label and full composition and care symbols.
  • Be sceptical of prices far below the wholesale list price for a non-outlet item.

Which shop should you choose?

  • Cheapest price for one to twenty pieces, delivered in a few days: Marmalade Co. — €6.95 tees, €20.95 hoodies, €7 DHL, 2–3 business days, price guarantee.
  • Exact model or colour that discount shops do not stock: the official fruitoftheloom.eu shop, or Amazon.de for the widest marketplace selection.
  • Ireland, want to try it on or collect: Country Clothing in Sligo.
  • Printed or embroidered with no minimum order: Clothes2order Ireland or Textil-Großhandel.eu.
  • Bulk blanks for a club, school or print business: Ntextil or Textil-Großhandel.eu at wholesale prices — or Marmalade Co.'s 10 % quantity discount if you only need a few dozen.

Before ordering anywhere, check the {{LINK:size-guide|Fruit of the Loom size guide}} — sizing is consistent across shops, so getting it right once saves a return.

faq.q: Where is the cheapest place to buy Fruit of the Loom in Europe?
faq.a: The cheapest verified option for private customers is Marmalade Co., an official Fruit of the Loom retailer that buys directly from the brand's factory in Morocco: T-shirts €6.95 (€6.26 at 5+), hoodies €20.95 (€18.86 at 5+), €7 DHL shipping with 2–3 business day delivery to Ireland and 10 EU countries, and a price guarantee on identical products.

faq.q: Can I buy Fruit of the Loom in Ireland?
faq.a: Yes. Online, Marmalade Co. delivers to Ireland by DHL in 2–3 business days, Amazon.ie sells in EUR with delivery within Ireland, EMP Ireland ships by DHL and Clothes2order Ireland prints and ships from the UK. For a physical shop, Country Clothing in Kintogher, Sligo stocks around 50 Fruit of the Loom items with click-and-collect and 30-day returns.

faq.q: Does Fruit of the Loom have its own online shop in Europe?
faq.a: Yes — fruitoftheloom.eu, run by Fruit of the Loom International from Kaiserslautern, Germany. It carries the complete current catalogue and is the best reference for official style numbers and colours, though prices are generally higher than at discount retailers. fruitotl.com is independent and not affiliated with Fruit of the Loom International.

faq.q: How long does delivery take from Marmalade Co.?
faq.a: Orders are dispatched within 0–1 business day from Denmark and delivered by DHL in an estimated 2–3 business days to Ireland, Germany, France, the Netherlands, Belgium, Austria, Italy, Spain, Portugal, Poland and Finland. Shipping is a flat €7 with no free-shipping threshold, and tracking is sent by e-mail.

faq.q: Where can a club or business buy Fruit of the Loom in bulk?
faq.a: Wholesalers such as Ntextil in Ireland (60+ styles, XS–5XL, dispatch within 48 hours) and Textil-Großhandel.eu in Germany (full catalogue, in-house printing, prices after registration) serve printers, clubs and businesses. For a few dozen pieces without a business account, Marmalade Co.'s 10 % discount at 5+ pieces is often just as cheap.

faq.q: Can I return Fruit of the Loom clothing bought online?
faq.a: Under EU consumer rules you can normally return unused items bought online within 14 days of delivery; individual shops may offer longer, for example 30 days at Country Clothing. Personalised or printed garments are usually excluded from returns, so check the size chart carefully before ordering anything with a print.
